messages:
taryn: quick kickoff  want to run a small 'launch pad' for a refapp tutorial + benchmarks as a lightning demo series
oliver: like 3 short demos over 3 weeks? each with a tiny notebook + replayable GH Action to run benches
mina: love the GH Action idea  makes "benchmarks-as-code" shareable. we can attach a badge to the repo
kevin: timeline proposal: week1 blog + notebook + action, week2 demo 1 (intro), week3 demo 2 (deep dive), week4 wrap + benchmarking writeup
taryn: assets: blog post, notebook, GH Action, landing page, 2 social threads, partner one-pager. i'll draft landing copy Tue
mina: notebook should include `how we measured` (env, seed, warmup) and a tiny run snippet:
```python
from redwood_bench import run
run(model='rw-small', seq=256, batch=4)
```
oliver: GH Action sketch (very small):
```yaml
name: bench
on: workflow_dispatch
jobs:
  bench:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - run: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: python notebooks/run_bench.py
```
kevin: inbound routing: HubSpot tags `launchpad-demo`, `notebook-download`; set up 3-email nurture (announce, reminder, post)
hubspot-bot: created form "Launchpad Demo RSVP" with tag `launchpad-demo`; will create nurture seq
taryn: gating: notebook download asks for email; repo public but run artifacts and CSV bench results gated behind form (easy opt-in)
mina: for reproducibility add a small Dockerfile + `run_bench.sh` so users can replicate locally or in CI
oliver: ops: we'll need a dry-run for demo 1 two days before. schedule dry-run and recording checks
kevin: webinar format: 20m demo, 10m Q&A, quick 10m workshop room for hands-on. registrants get notebook, GH Action link, and 50 quickstart credits
taryn: PR rules: open to `community-launch` repo; branch prefix `launchpad/` and include checklist in PR body
mina: messaging: lean into "benchmarks-as-code" and "reproducible inference" rather than generic performance claims
oliver: small ask  add a short screenshot of the helm chart playground in partner 1-pager to show deployment options (hosted/dedicated/private)
taryn: will assign Asana tasks and send invites. thanks team! :rocket:
